summary: Phase ADMOD.1 (Ad Manager + Unified Creative Approval Workflow) end-to-end verification. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admod1_ad_review.py covering /api/ad-pricing-hints, ad_manager RBAC (promote/gate/revert), publish→auto-moderation+review-row, approve→live, reject→advertiser badge, require_changes→draft→resubmit, bulk-approve, block/unblock (HTTP 403 detail.code='advertiser_blocked'), analytics, audit-log, and OpenAPI listing. AD.4 regression suite (test_ad4_coupon_pay_per_save.py) 10/10 green after rate-limit cooldown — no behavior change. Frontend: /admin/ad-review renders full 4-tab surface (queue with 4 pending rows, analytics with 4 KPI cards + 14-day bar, blocked, audit table), detail modal opens with advertiser/AI moderation/creative sections + approve/reject/require-changes/block buttons, approve action removes row from queue, bulk-approve toggles when >=2 checkboxes selected. Advertiser dashboard shows 12 advertiser-coupon-review-{id} badges (APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED), rejected campaign displays reason inline, blocked banner appears after admin block AND new-campaign button becomes disabled — banner disappears and button re-enables on unblock. Auto-moderation confirmed running (action_taken='clean' on benign copy in DB). All test data cleaned up: advertiser unblocked, test user role reverted to business_partner, AD.4 demo fixture cc_ad4_demo_karak still live.

minor.issue: Rate limit (15/min) tripped when running AD.4 regression back-to-back with ADMOD.1 tests — one 60s cooldown resolves. Not a regression, pre-existing.

ui_bugs.issue: Category tags input at line 555 has no data-testid='advertiser-coupon-wizard-categories' (spec required). Only cost_per_save/inventory inputs have testids. Impact: automated verification that hint value updates when categories change is not directly wireable through the input.

issues: Route renders but body background stays rgb(10,10,15) (same as legacy). Whether radiolife theme is meant to only affect certain screens (e.g. /offers, advertiser) and NOT admin ops screens is unclear from spec — flagging as observation, not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Auto-moderation implementation is clean: /api/ad-review/queue/{id} responses embed auto_moderation_result with action_taken ∈ {clean,flagged,error,skipped,empty_input,None} — verified 'clean' on benign copy. Graceful skip path is protected as spec requires.

Advertiser-blocked hard-gate on AD.4 publish returns HTTP 403 with detail={'code':'advertiser_blocked'} exactly as the frontend surfaces the banner and disables the new-button. Contract is coherent end-to-end.
ad_manager RBAC via require_ad_manager works: PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role now accepts 'ad_manager', re-login reflects new role, /api/ad-review/queue returns 200, /api/admin/users returns 403.
AD.4 regression fully green — publish→review flow does not disturb existing coupon-campaigns.live listing, save flow, split routing, or wallet accounting.
MINOR: `advertiser-coupon-wizard-categories` testid missing per ADMOD.1 spec — trivial fix but blocks that specific auto-test.
